observations: Three photos show a white console with a black horizontal stripe, resembling a PlayStation 5 console, placed on a black leather surface.
Two controllers are visible in front: one black and one white, both with the same design (DualSense style).
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections and minor smudges.
The background is a marble-patterned wall, and the photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI GEMINI GADGETS'.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.
No ports, labels, or model numbers are visible on the console or controllers in any photo.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean in photos, but 'UK used' cannot be verified remotely. No proof of origin or usage history.
Two controllers are shown, but no labels, serial numbers, or packaging are visible to confirm they are 'original'.
No games or game cases are visible in any photo. The FC26 package cannot be confirmed or denied remotely.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-original or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controllers showing serial numbers, labels, or packaging, or a video of them being used.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated
risks.proof: Photos of the game cases or digital game library screen showing 10 games installed.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit
risks.proof: Close-up of the console's model label or serial number, or a video of the console's system settings showing the model.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Close-up photos of the console's model label or serial number.
Photos of the game cases or digital game library screen showing 10 games installed.
Close-up photos of the controllers showing serial numbers or labels.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
